Overview

Van is a city in Van with a population of 615,000. A city on the eastern shore of Lake Van, known for its stunning turquoise lake, Van cat, and ancient Urartian ruins. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year.
